scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: An operation needs a model
scenes.caption: Asha organises a fictional festival desk. Registrations have stable identifiers, edits need an undo history and support tickets arrive in order. The team should choose a data structure for the required operation, rather than put everything into one undifferentiated list.
scenes.dialogue: What must happen next to each item?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Different orders mean different behaviour
scenes.caption: An ordered list preserves a sequence. A keyed lookup retrieves by a unique stable ID. A stack removes the latest added item first; a queue serves the earliest waiting item first. A name is not necessarily a unique key.
scenes.dialogue: Undo and first-come support need different removal orders.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Trace the next operation
scenes.caption: The undo stack contains U1, U2 and then U3. The latest action is U3. The support queue contains T1, T2 and then T3; T1 is served next. These are abstract operation rules, not measurements of a particular implementation.
scenes.dialogue: Predict, run and inspect the remaining items.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the support model
scenes.caption: For first-come support, should the newest ticket jump ahead, should names determine identity, or should the earliest waiting ticket be served from a queue?
scenes.dialogue: The structure should express the required policy.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A model with limits
scenes.caption: Asha keeps stable-ID lookup separate from arrival order and undo history. Duplicate IDs must be reviewed before a unique lookup is trusted. A priority exception is a policy change for a person to authorise, not something the data structure decides.
scenes.dialogue: A useful model makes its assumptions visible.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the reliability lab
scenes.caption: Match operations to structures, predict and run stack and queue removals, then state the uniqueness and policy limits. No real registration data or live support tickets are used.
scenes.dialogue: Choose the model from the operation.
